No pressure at all! Thank you for creating such a valuable tool with Ideogram — it truly enhances our directory.

Warm regards,  
AllAIDunia Team

proposed_message.subject: HeyGen on AllAIDunia — featured placement option
proposed_message.body:
Hi HeyGen team,

I hope this message finds you well! I wanted to share that HeyGen is already featured on AllAIDunia (https://www.allaidunia.com/#heygen), which is a carefully curated directory of AI tools designed to be user-friendly for both people and AI answer engines.

We're excited to offer some special featured placement options to help boost your visibility:

- Featured Listing — $49/mo: This includes top-of-category placement, a "Featured" badge, and priority in AI Tool Matchmaker results.
- Homepage Spotlight — $99/mo: A rotating banner slot on our homepage, along with all the benefits of the Featured Listing and a mention in our monthly tools roundup.
- Category Sponsor — $149/mo: Enjoy exclusive top placement in one category without any competitor sharing the space, plus all the Homepage Spotlight benefits.

We’re still in the early stages and would love to keep this opportunity limited to a small founding group at these rates before they increase. If you’d like more details or if this isn’t the right time for you, that’s completely okay too. Just let me know!

Warm regards,  
AllAIDunia Team
